scope: Propagate failed copy fallbacks from extractArchive; preserve the existing self-copy exception.
limitations: Prepared source artifact only; no installed host or full upstream build/typecheck acceptance.
Existing remove-before-copy, overwrite defaults and missing-source warning behavior remain unchanged; no no-clobber or ownership guarantee.
Concurrent transfers may still be running when a worker rejects; rejection is not extractor/child termination or permission to clean up.
The legacy self-copy exception and message heuristic remain; source-derived tests use owned filesystem/API stubs without native effects.
